mapper.sql: select e.expense_id, e.expense_no, e.applicant_id, e.dept_id, e.expense_type, e.amount, e.expense_date, e.invoice_count, e.description, e.status, e.submit_time, e.pay_time, e.create_by, e.create_time, e.update_by, e.update_time, e.remark, u.nick_name as applicant_name, d.dept_name from biz_expense e left join sys_user u on u.user_id = e.applicant_id left join sys_dept d on d.dept_id = e.dept_id
mapper.insert: insert into biz_expense (expense_no, applicant_id, dept_id, expense_type, amount, expense_date, invoice_count, description, status, create_by, create_time, remark) values (#{expenseNo}, #{applicantId}, #{deptId}, #{expenseType}, #{amount}, #{expenseDate}, #{invoiceCount}, #{description}, #{status}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark})
